name: Chapter Rail
summary: Right-edge scroll rail (one dot per section, the current dot morphs into a pill that fills with the section) plus a pinned scroll story: captions blur-swap while a scrubbed element animates.
useWhen: A long landing page needs a quiet where-am-I indicator with jump links
You want a scroll progress cue that does not take a header or sidebar
A product feature is best explained as one object changing step by step, with a pinned visual
A landing page needs a scroll-driven walkthrough that the rail also tracks
avoidWhen: The page has two or three sections
Mobile must show section navigation (the rail is hidden below 80rem)
Pinned scrolling would fight a nested scroll container
source: https://github.com/Meerzus/cloudlet (apps/site chapters, Life of a notification)
